checks.name: the board file loads at all
checks.fix: the board is the whole draft — nothing below matters until this passes

checks.name: keepers.json loads
league_config.json loads
league_config declares Cory's draft slot
keepers.json has a row for Cory's slot (8)
checks.fix: without this the whole keeper comparison is vacuous

checks.name: Cory's draft slot is NOT provisional — a moving seat moves every pick
CONTROL — Cory actually has keepers to check (a comparison of two empty lists passes and proves nothing)
keeper COUNT matches between keepers.json and the board
keeper PLAYER IDS match exactly — keepers.json vs board.kept_players

checks.name: board.kept_player_ids agrees with board.kept_players — the board's TWO keeper lists must not disagree with each other
keeper NAMES AND POSITIONS match, not just ids — an id that resolves to a different man is the worst version of this failure
his keepers are FLAGGED on the board so the engine cannot recommend a man he already owns (report-only: the board may mark this by exclusion rather than a flag — see detail)
FOR THE HUMAN — read these three and confirm they are yours
the board carries a keeper_slate at all — an ABSENT slate is how a missing-key None slipped past an `is False` assertion tonight (register 151)
the keeper lock has PASSED on Sleeper
the importer calls the slate TRUTH, not a prediction
checks.fix: status "predicted" means opponent keepers are GUESSES

checks.name: every team has designated — a missing team is an unknown keeper, which is an unknown player still on the board
no designation/placement MISMATCHES — a mismatch means Sleeper and our config disagree about who somebody kept
the pre-draft freeze exists
the freeze is SEALED, not PROVISIONAL — a provisional freeze was built on PREDICTED opponent keepers
checks.fix: delete draft/data/pre_draft_freeze_2026.json and re-take it AFTER the slate confirms (freeze_pre_draft.py refuses to overwrite by design)

checks.name: the board was built within the last 24 hours
checks.fix: ADP, injuries and suspensions all move daily — rebuild before drafting

checks.name: the board has a real player population

the seat plan knows Cory's picks
he has TWELVE picks — register 98 was an eighteen-pick artifact quoted for hours after his real twelve were known
picks + keepers fill the roster (15 of 15)
every artifact the war room fetches exists
the alternate source boards were built from THIS board — a toggle serving pre-lock replacement levels is worse than no toggle

board_input_staleness: nothing derived predates the board it came from
